_: Problems the review of 4 November found and reported to the owner without fixing them (a decision for the owner, or a change to a tuned fight's balance). Each entry: the review check (tests/<test>.js), the text it matches in a problem, the bug and why it is not fixed. A case whose every problem matches an entry is KNOWN, not FAIL; take an entry off when the bug is fixed.

known.match: Ashwatthama (enemy) holds bow but strikes with sword
known.bug: The night raid (e_raid, e_ash): Ashwatthama is drawn with his bow but strikes with a sword he takes up (Rig.wield), against the rule that every foe strikes with what he is drawn holding and archers only shoot.
known.why: Making him an archer who only shoots changes a tuned deadly fight (RT.TUNE e_raid 1.1); the owner should choose: an archer (and re-tune), or drawn with a sword in the raid.
known.file: game/js/engine/realtime.js profile() (archer by name or by having no melee move); game/js/content/act6b.js e_raid, e_ash
